column1: # KISS-Conform — the coverage RATCHET floor.
# `python tools/kiss_trace.py --ratchet` compares the live figures against these
# three and fails on ANY deviation. It is a second mode, not a replacement for
# `--strict`: --strict is §6.2 as literally written (913/913 or red) and stays
# available under its own flag. This mode exists because a check that has always
# been red teaches everyone to ignore it, and would not be noticed when it started
# failing for a NEW reason.
#   harness    clauses backed by executable code           MUST NOT decrease
#   lint       clauses enforced by a document lint         MUST NOT decrease
#   untested   genuinely untested MUSTs — the real gap     MUST NOT increase
# THREE NUMBERS, NOT ONE, and that is the whole design:
#   * A ratchet on `untested` alone is gameable by RECLASSIFICATION. PR #177 moved
#     untested 515 -> 502 while ENFORCED stayed at exactly 390/913: thirteen rows
#     changed their EXPLANATION and nothing was tested. A one-number ratchet would
#     have called that progress. Requiring `harness` to hold at the same time makes
#     a reclassification neutral rather than green.
#   * `ENFORCED = harness + lint` is a sum of unequal parts, so the pair must be
#     stored SEPARATELY. #187 records the case: an incidental citation credited a
#     lint-enforced clause to the harness — harness +1, lint -1, ENFORCED
#     unchanged. A ratchet on the sum cannot see a document lint being replaced by
#     a string match inside one test.
#   * But the THREE COUNTS still cannot tell a lint->harness UPGRADE (a documentary
#     clause gaining a stronger behavioral test) from a laundered regression with the
#     identical signature — X: lint->untested plus an unrelated Y: untested->harness
#     nets harness +1 / lint -1 / untested flat, exactly a substitution (#213). So the
#     lint dimension is also compared as a SET: the tool reads UNBACKED.tsv at the PR
#     BASE (`--ratchet --base-ref <ref>`; the ledger is the only committed artifact
#     holding a PREVIOUS state, so the floor stays three human-reviewable numbers) and
#     requires that the IDs which LEFT lint are exactly the ones that ARRIVED in
#     harness. A move that passes is reported as a SUBSTITUTION — update the floor
#     harness +N / lint -N deliberately — not a regression. `--base-ref` is required on
#     any run that CAN determine a base (a git checkout), NOT gated on the lint count: a
#     constant-count lint<->harness swap leaves every count flat and would slip a count
#     gate. Only a genuinely git-less run may skip it, and it reports the lint dimension
#     as NOT characterized rather than at-the-floor. The base is read by ref, never from
#     the on-disk ledger (a regenerated ledger is already the new state — the currency
#     hazard).
# A DEVIATION IN EITHER DIRECTION FAILS.
#   worse  -> regression: coverage went backwards.
#   better -> the floor is STALE: lower it, in the same PR that earned it. That is
#             what makes this a ratchet rather than slack — green means AT the
#             floor, never somewhere under it.
# This file is COMMITTED and edited by hand. The tool never rewrites it: a floor
# the tool maintains is a state derived from the run rather than from a decision,
# and it would silently absorb a regression that happened to coincide with an
# improvement elsewhere.
# Set from main @ dedde77; harness raised 362 -> 368 by #199 (Refs #171): the six
# KISS-CLASSIFY-6.8-0008..-0013 namespace-vocabulary-manifest clauses are each
# harness-backed (conformance/tests/namespace_vocabulary.rs). lint and untested are
# unchanged — the six clauses are tested, not reclassified.
# harness 369 -> 372 / lint 35 -> 32 by the uncited-declared sweep (Refs #91),
# base main @ 0197def (#227 left the floor at 369/35/494). Three CLASSIFY clauses
# move from documentary (lint) to behavioral (harness) backing -- 6.1-0001 (closed
# dtype set), 6.5-0006 (closed op-family set), 6.5-0007 (work-class boundaries) --
# via tests already asserting them in structure_key_golden.rs (all 50 pass). This
# is a lint->harness SUBSTITUTION: ENFORCED holds at 404 and untested is UNCHANGED
# at 494 (genuine untested earn = 0). The moved IDs are removed from UNBACKED.tsv;
# the ratchet reports RATCHET SUBSTITUTION (#213/#215), confirmed
# substitution_recorded (#225), not a regression.
# harness 372 -> 373 by #219: KISS-CLASSIFY-6.6-0019 (the weight-role hint) is newly
# harness-backed by test_classify_weight_role_hint. base main @ b311f1c (372/32/494);
# one new normative clause, backed in the same PR, so lint (32) and untested (494) are
# UNCHANGED and total clauses 921 -> 922. The discriminating gem vector that pins the
# rule latently is HELD for a Fuel corpus re-vendor (== -> >=) and lands in a follow-up
# PR; it is a corpus artifact, not a clause, and moves no count here.
# Re-derived on main @ f8a2a23 for #212/#218; NOT carried from any earlier base.
# harness 373 -> 377: the four KISS-CONFORM-6.3-0005..-0008 published-artifact clauses
# each name a test already in conformance/tests/structure_key_vectors.rs. lint 32 and
# untested 494 UNCHANGED -- the clauses arrive backed, so no new normative text enters
# the ledger, and -0009 is deliberately absent (it can only be backed by moving published
# artifact bytes; it ships with its test in the coordinated cut -- #218).
# THIS NUMBER HAS NOW BEEN RE-DERIVED THREE TIMES, and was wrong the first two, because
# the base moved under it while the branch sat in review: 368+4=372, then 372+4=376, now
# 373+4=377. The +4 was right every time; the BASE was stale every time. Worse, the first
# stale value (372) was numerically EQUAL to what #243's lint->harness substitution had
# meanwhile put on main, so 'harness matches main' CONFIRMED the wrong number. A floor is
# a dated measurement, not a property of the branch: re-derive at the actual merge base
# with `--ratchet --base-ref origin/main` immediately before merge, and never carry an
# arithmetic result across a rebase.
# EXIT STATES of `--ratchet`, because this file's whole rationale is that a check which is
# always red teaches everyone to ignore it:
#   0  CLEAN         at the floor.
#   1  VIOLATIONS    the floor moved -- the word reserved for exactly that.
#   2  INCONCLUSIVE  the counts were compared, but --base-ref was absent so the lint SET
#                    could not be diffed against the base ledger. NOT a pass and NOT a
#                    violation. CI always passes --base-ref, so this state is only ever
#                    seen by a human spot-checking by hand -- the reader least equipped to
#                    tell a false alarm from a real one, which is why it gets its own word.
#  A genuine floor breach OUTRANKS the refusal and still reports 1, so a missing flag can
#  never mask a regression.
# harness 377 -> 378 by #257 (Refs #230): KISS-EMIT-6.4-0006 (spellable is not
# computable) arrives BACKED in the same PR that earns it, by
# test_emit_spellable_is_not_computable. lint (32) and untested (494) UNCHANGED --
# the clause is tested, not reclassified -- and total clauses 926 -> 927.
# DERIVED BY THE TOOL, NOT BY ARITHMETIC: `--ratchet --base-ref origin/main`
# reported "Set the floor to harness 378, lint 32, untested 494" and that output is
# pasted here. This file's own history is the argument for doing it that way -- the
# 377 above was re-derived three times and wrong twice, because the base moved while
# the branch sat in review, and one stale value was numerically EQUAL to what a
# meanwhile-merged substitution had put on main, so "harness matches main" CONFIRMED
# the wrong number.
# STALE BY CONSTRUCTION IF #238 LANDS FIRST. #238 also moves the floor (377 -> 379,
# two new backed §6.3 clauses), so the two are in flight simultaneously and NEITHER
# can write a number now that is right at merge:
#   #257 first -> floor 378, and #238 must re-derive to 380, not 379.
#   #238 first -> floor 379, and #257 must re-derive to 380, not 378.
# Whoever merges SECOND re-derives with `--ratchet --base-ref origin/main` against
# the actual post-merge main and pastes the tool output. Do not add the deltas.
# Re-derived on main @ 69c535b for #265/#268. lint 32 -> 33: KISS-CONFORM-6.8-0012
# (comparators declare what they normalize) is enforced by tools/kiss_comparators.py, a
# document lint, so it lands in the lint dimension rather than harness. harness 378 and
# untested 494 UNCHANGED -- the clause arrives WITH its detector, which is the move #269's
# arrival_recorded verdict now recognizes (#267). Before that verdict existed this branch
# read as lint_drift: a clause shipping with its enforcement had no green path.
# harness 378 -> 375 / untested 494 -> 497 by #187 (the backing-vs-mention scanner), on top
# of #261's recorded-move verdicts (merged in #269). The scanner counts only a BACKING form
# (an assert_golden/assert_token first-arg, or a `Backs:`/`Enforces` keyworded comment); it
# dropped 13 reverse-cited clauses. 10 were mutation-verified GENUINE backings in a bare-comment
# form and MIGRATED to `// Backs:` (no count change); 3 -- KISS-EMIT-6.4-0001/-0002/-0005 -- are
# genuine MENTIONS (lookup keys inside test_emit_constants_are_emitter_supplied, which asserts
# §6.2-0002, #191). Mutating THEIR OWN obligation reddens no test, so they are de-credited:
# marked `decredited` in UNBACKED.tsv, rolled into the untested TOTAL. A DE-CREDITING, not a
# regression -- harness -3 / untested +3 -- reported `decrediting_recorded` GREEN (#261). lint is
# 33, not 32: #268 landed its §6.8-0012 lint on main first, and the de-crediting leaves lint alone.
# DERIVED BY THE TOOL, NOT BY ARITHMETIC: `--ratchet --base-ref origin/main` on the merged tree
# (main @ afcd839, after #257/#269/#268) reported "Update the floor to harness 375, untested 497"
# and that output is pasted here. Base was #268's 378/33/494, NOT any earlier tip -- carrying a
# stale base across a rebase is the exact trap the entries above record. KISS squash-merges, so
# this branch rebased with `--onto origin/main <old-base>` to replay only the #187 commit.
# harness 375 -> 377 by #238: KISS-CONFORM-6.3-0010 (the reference artifact's normative
# surface, declared in THREE parts -- vector content / scoping declarations / provenance) and
# -0011 (cardinality is NOT a conformance surface) are each harness-backed in this PR --
# test_reference_artifact_normative_surface_is_declared and
# test_published_vector_counts_are_not_a_conformance_surface. Both clauses arrive WITH their
# backing, so lint (33) and untested (497) are UNCHANGED; total clauses 928 -> 930.
# Neither clause moves an artifact byte: the normative surface is declared in the
# SPECIFICATION, not in a new artifact field. That is what dissolves the circularity in #238
# and lets it land without a coordinated regeneration across consumers.
# DERIVED BY THE TOOL, NOT BY ARITHMETIC. This entry replaces an earlier 380/33/494 that was
# correct against #268's 378 base AND IS NOW MEANINGLESS, because #270 merged underneath it
# (harness 378 -> 375, untested 494 -> 497). Rebased with `--onto origin/main <old-base>`:
# KISS squash-merges, so an already-merged branch is upstream by CONTENT but not by HASH and a
# plain rebase replays it into a conflict.
# WORTH RECORDING BECAUSE IT LOOKS LIKE THE OPPOSITE LESSON: naive arithmetic (375 + 2) gives
# 377 and the tool ALSO gives 377. They agree only because #270 de-credited three KISS-EMIT
# clauses, disjoint from the two added here. Disjointness is exactly what the arithmetic
# ASSUMES and what the tool ESTABLISHES -- the agreement is a fact about this pair of changes,
# not evidence that the shortcut works. The prior entry in this file records the same shortcut
# being WRONG one merge earlier.
# harness 377 -> 378 by #265: KISS-CONFORM-6.8-0013 (a declared blindness must be EXHIBITED)
# arrives with test_conform_declared_blindness_is_exhibited, a harness test, so it lands in the
# harness dimension. lint 33 and untested 497 UNCHANGED -- the clause ships with its detector.
# Tool-derived at main @ cded43d, pasted, not computed by hand.
# harness 378 -> 380, untested 497 -> 496 by #275 (freeze-blocker: admission / identity /
# selection are three questions with two clauses). TOOL-DERIVED on the merge tree, not
# arithmetic -- `--ratchet --base-ref origin/main` reported "Set the floor to harness 380,
# lint 33, untested 496" and that output is pasted here.
# The +2 harness / -1 untested is NOT two new clauses: KISS-CLASSIFY-6.6-0020 (selection) is
# new AND backed, and KISS-CLASSIFY-6.6-0002 was ALREADY NORMATIVE AND UNBACKED -- ledgered
# `untested` with an EMPTY reason field. It is the clause a consumer cited to establish that
# the substitutable-dispatch precondition was already covered; the obligation existed only as
# prose, with nothing checking it. Backing it is the larger half of this change.
# KISS-CLASSIFY-6.6-0001 is amended, not added: the biconditional weakens to necessary-but-
# not-sufficient. Its count does not move and its existing test still passes -- because that
# test only ever asserted the ONLY-IF direction (one-field-different variants must not match).
# THE REMOVED DIRECTION WAS NEVER BACKED BY THE TEST THAT NAMED THE CLAUSE, so removing it
# de-credits nothing. Three consumers independently confirmed no reliance (see the PR).
# FOURTH DIMENSION — `proven` (#278). The `harness` count credits a clause the moment a test
# NAMES or CITES it, which spans three strengths of evidence (convention 15): a name coincidence
# (NAMED), a human-asserted citation (CITED, deliberateness), and a mutation-verified backing
# (PROVEN, aboutness). `proven` counts only the last: a clause carrying a `// Proven:` marker —
# testimony that a seeded mutation of its obligation was shown to redden its test.
#   proven     clauses with a mutation-proof marker        MUST NOT decrease (with one exception)
# It STARTS AT 0 and is ARMED, not vacuous: it can only rise as proofs are earned per-clause
# (never bulk-marked). The one sanctioned DECREASE is a proof RETIREMENT — a proof drops green
# IFF its proving TEST no longer exists in the harness (the testimony was about that test; the
# test is gone, so the testimony is void). A marker removed while its proving test SURVIVES is a
# regression, always — a stale proof claiming aboutness it has lost is worse than no proof. When
# a legitimate retirement drops the count, bump this number down in the same PR, exactly as a
# `stale` improvement bumps it up. See #278 and classify_proven().
# untested 496 -> 495 by the KISS-EMIT-6.4-0005 RECLASSIFICATION, REBASED onto #297's floor.
# TOOL-DERIVED: `--ratchet --base-ref origin/main` on the rebased tree reported "Set the floor to
# harness 380, lint 33, untested 495" and prints `proven at the floor - 0` separately.
# THIS IS NOT A COVERAGE IMPROVEMENT AND MUST NOT BE READ AS ONE. No test was written and the
# clause is no better exercised. The row moved from `decredited` (which rolls into the
# genuinely-untested total) to `blocked` (accounted for), because the KISS-Emit editor of record
# established WHY it cannot be tested and WHEN that ends.
# The reason: §6.4-0005's subject is the COMPLEMENT OF AN AUDIT RESULT -- "any operator the
# neutrality audit (§6.5) did not prove universal". §6.5-0001 makes the recorded audit manifest a
# FREEZE PRECONDITION, so at Draft maturity no manifest exists, the set has no value, and no test
# can construct a member -- therefore none can construct a violation. Recording it `untested`
# INVITES SOMEONE TO WRITE A TEST THAT CANNOT EXIST; `blocked` names when it stops being blocked.
# A downward move in `untested` with no test written is exactly the shape that can launder a
# regression, so it is recorded here rather than only in the ledger note: the mechanism is a
# category change, the authority is the sub-standard's editor, and the unblock condition is a
# named artifact the spec itself sequences.
# REBASE NOTE: #297 landed the 4th dimension (`proven`) while this sat. The conflict was resolved
# by taking main's floor whole and RE-DERIVING with the tool rather than hand-merging the two
# numbers -- `untested` was the only row this change touches, and `proven 0` is #297's to own.
# REBASE NOTE (#311 PROVEN batch 1, after #302): #302 moved untested 496 -> 495 (EMIT-6.4-0005
# reclassified) while this branch held untested 496 + proven 9, so the floor block conflicted.
# Resolved by taking MAIN'S floor whole (untested 495, proven 0) and RE-DERIVING with
# `--ratchet --base-ref origin/main`, which reported "untested at the floor 495" and "proven rose
# 0 -> 9, bump to 9" -- NOT by hand-assembling untested-495-from-one-side + proven-9-from-the-other
# (the tool-unchecked number the ratchet exists to reject). harness/lint UNCHANGED. Green
# traceability CI on the rebased branch is the verification, not this paste.
# proven 9 -> 10 by the KISS-CONTRACT-6.1-0008 NAMED->CITED->PROVEN migration (#278 follow-up).
# The clause was demonstrated in batch 1 (ee1d186 / PROVEN_BATCH1.md row 36: mutating read_document's
# `version != "1"` -> `!= "2"` reddens EXACTLY test_contract_version_value_pinned) but DEFERRED as
# NAMED-not-CITED: the test named the clause only in assert MESSAGES -- a MENTION, not a backing form
# -- so it was harness-NAMED with no `// Backs:`. This PR adds the `// Backs:` (NAMED->CITED, harness
# UNCHANGED: NAMED 241->240 / CITED 139->140, both inside the 380) and the `// Proven:` marker.
# The ONLY floor dimension that moves is proven; harness/lint/untested are UNCHANGED.
# TOOL-DERIVED, NOT ARITHMETIC: `--ratchet --base-ref origin/main` reported "proven rose 9 -> 10:
# 1 proof(s) earned. Bump the proven floor in this PR" and that output is pasted here.
# The `// Proven:` marker is TESTIMONY to a demonstration at a ref, not a live re-run. It is grounded
# on green main (9c8543b) by FILE-INVARIANCE, not re-mutation: `git diff --quiet ee1d186 9c8543b --
# conformance/src/contract.rs conformance/tests/contract_framing.rs` exits 0 (byte-identical), so the
# recorded mutation site and its target test are unchanged and the demonstration applies bit-for-bit.
# A live re-mutation of the source was refused by the sandbox classifier; file-invariance is the
# stronger grounding anyway -- the subject bytes cannot have drifted -- and needs no source edit.
# key
harness
lint
untested
proven
